changes.reason: Increase function count to 13 to cover states in frozen window up to 3.5 eV above Fermi

diagnosis: The calculation refuses to start because the frozen window contains more states than there are Wannier functions to represent them. The frozen window extends to 3.5 eV above the Fermi level, and with the current projector set (Sr: s,p and O: s,p) we have only 8 Wannier functions total (Sr: 1+3=4, O: 1+3=4). The band gap is at 3.33 eV, so the frozen window is reaching into the conduction bands. In this isolated manifold, we need more Wannier functions to represent all the states up to that energy. The previous attempt with Sr:s,p,d and O:s,s,p,p (14 functions total) caused an MPI abort, likely because it implied too many functions for the 34 bands available. We need an intermediate count that fits within the frozen window requirement.
